instructions: You are a participant in an a psychological experiment. Perform the task as instructed.

task1.instruct: You will be given a pair words in each trial. in a trial when its a complete word pair then type the second word. When its an incompolete word pair with one word and a blank then fill in the second word for answer. Also rate the relatedness on the scale of 0 to 100 between the both the words in the word pairs. Reply READY to start with the trials.

task2.instruct: Respond on each trial whether it is a non-word, uppercaseword, lower case word. Reply READY to start with the trials.

task3.instruct: On each trial a word will be given and respond whether the given word is a new word or had second word given by the use or was the second word generated by ai. Thus you have three options to choose from: (1) new word, (2) user-given second word, (3) ai-generated second word. Reply READY to start with the trials.

response_schema_postfix.task1: Reply format => Second Word: x and Relatedness between words in the word-pairs: y/100%. Only report the second word and relatedness rating and do not provide any explanation.
response_schema_postfix.task2: Reply in the format => Answer: x-word. Where x is upper, lower or non. Only report your choice and do not provide any explanation.
response_schema_postfix.task3: Reply in the format => Answer: x-word and Confidence: y/6. Where x is new, user-second or ai-second and y is the rating on the scale of 1 to 6 for the confidence level in the judgment. Only report your choice, and confidence in your choice, and do not provide any explanation.
